blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Seventeen business groups have thrown their support behind newly appointed Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) Commissioner Rolando Ligon Jr. and pledged to work with the agency to address taxpayer concerns and encourage voluntary tax compliance. In a joint manifesto, the groups said they were confident Ligon could modernize the bureau, strengthen institutional integrity and carry out taxpayer-friendly reforms.
